title: Query an OGC API Features collection through the contract Dataset
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that queries the OGC API Features collection "eval-incidents" served under the base URL in HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL. Use the protocol-neutral contract API from @honua/sdk-js: build a HonuaClient with { baseUrl }, then createDataset from @honua/sdk-js/contract with one source { id: "incidents", protocol: "ogc-features", locator: { url: <base URL>, collectionId: "eval-incidents" }, capabilities: PROTOCOL_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES["ogc-features"] } and skipCompatibilityCheck: true (the target is not a Honua server). Query it with { where: "priority = 'high'", pagination: { limit: 10 } }. The Result contract exposes features (an array of { attributes, geometry }) and totalCount. Print exactly one line to stdout: {"count": <result.features.length>, "totalCount": <result.totalCount>, "firstName": <name attribute of the first feature>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: same typed Query over OGC API Features; where compiles to CQL2 text.
